The '''Rodian rumba''' was a genre of [[Music/Legends|music]] that might have originated in [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]].

A band playing in the [[Cantina|Bar]] of [[Darkside (space station)|Darkside]] during a payday in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] played something that sounded like a kind of Rodian rumba.
